product_summary: Site starsintered.com (live, checked) lists: powders (tin, copper), tool room / CNC division, sintered structural parts, sintered bushes, sheet metal & cold forging parts, sintered bronze filters, motor cover assembly, metal graphite brushes & assy, HVAC & sinter brazing parts, ferrite parts, compressor parts, carbon neutral pellets. About Us page states the group (Star Group of Industries, founded 12.02.1992) manufactures and exports 'more than 5000 different types of ferrous and non-ferrous parts' mainly for automotive, business machines, shock absorbers, home appliances, ferrite magnet parts, soft ferrite parts, ferrite impeder rod and toroidal core, lock parts, refrigeration compressor parts, sintered bronze filters, automotive machined parts and sheet metal components. Individual product sub-pages (ferrite-parts, sintered-bushes, sintered-products) return empty pages — no specifications, no HS references, no catalogue PDFs.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-described manufacturer & exporter of powder-metallurgy, ferrite and sheet-metal parts; no trader signs found on site — no 'we are trading house', no third-party brand resale). Note: legal name on site is presented as 'Star Group of Industries Ltd' / 'Star Sintered Products' — the exact registered form 'STAR SINTERED PRODUCTS LIMITED' is not confirmed on the website, so entity-name match is unverified.
comment: HS 850511 (permanent magnets of metal, incl. ferrite) is only ONE of at least 11 declared product lines and covers just the ferrite magnet / soft ferrite / toroidal core part of the range. It is therefore PARTIAL, not exact: the bulk of the range (sintered structural parts, bushes, bronze filters, metal graphite brushes, sheet metal/cold forging, compressor and HVAC parts, tin/copper powders) falls in Ch. 73/74/80/85 (brushes 8545/8533) and is not represented by 850511. Industry claim 'Энергетика' (power/energy) is a misclassification: the site positions the company in automotive components, home appliances, business machines, shock absorbers and refrigeration compressors — i.e. auto components / electrical machine parts, not power generation or energy equipment. Trader signs: none found. Product lines missing from the declaration: sintered bushes and structural parts, sintered bronze filters, metal graphite brushes, sheet metal & cold forging parts, motor cover assembly, HVAC/brazing parts, compressor parts, tin and copper powders, carbon neutral pellets. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground — company stays in the base with corrected codes and verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data above is website-declared only: no customs line, invoice or B-L was reviewed in this task, so every code is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue, export volumes, PAN/CIN and registry data were deliberately not researched (out of scope for this role) — null.
